title: Sears Hill Bridge and Woodrow Park Overlook
description: Cross the historic 1905 iron footbridge high above the train tracks, then follow the steep stairs into Woodrow Park for one of Staunton’s most magical views. Interpretive signs highlight the city’s history and architecture. Open 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Please note: The route includes steep stairs .

title: Devil's Snare Photo Op
description: Are you brave enough to face the Devil's Snare? Check out our indoor photo op, show us your best escape pose, and see if you can survive the vines! Don't forget to relax with a bite to eat and a house-made butter brew (spiked or otherwise) in our limited souvenir mugs!

title: Magical Reset: Acu-Wellness
venue: Legacy of the Rose Center for Healing and Enlightenment
description: Meet and Greet with Psychic Mediums Ashley Hallman, Founder of Legacy of the Rose Center for Healing and Enlightenment and Reverend Meg "The Happy Medium". Explore Legacy of the Rose, learn more about their work, and get a first look at everything planned for the weekend.

title: Mischief Before Midnight: A Magical Art-Cade Pre-Party
description: Start the magic a day early at The Art-Cade! Enjoy 90 minutes of unlimited arcade play while taking on the mysterious Arcane Quest—featuring crystals, magical trials, hidden clues, an Oracle, strange creatures and surprises. Costumes encouraged. $15 • Limited to 30 guests per session • All are welcome here.

title: Ghosts of Staunton's Queen City Ghost Tour
venue: New Street Parking Garage (corner by stoplight)
description: 75 Minute Walking Ghost Tour through town featuring some of Staunton's most haunted locations. Admission $13-$15 / Tickets can be purchased online or from our booth / start up location on S. New Street

title: Puffs, or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
description: “Puffs, Or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic” is a delightful theatrical production by Matt Cox, presented by the Silver Line Theatre Exchange in special arrangement with Concord Theatricals. This family-friendly show tells the story of the Puffs, a group of misfit students who navigate seven years at a certain Wizard School, overshadowed by a famous boy wizard who saves the world. This comedic tale is perfect for anyone who has ever felt less than extraordinary, featuring area university students aspiring to careers in theatre. While it is suitable for families, it does include scenes of violence, death, and sexual innuendo. The performance runs for approximately 110 minutes, with a 15-minute intermission.
